items.title: Jim Hall — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Gary Larson bought that guitar for me. It was very nice of him to do it. ... I’d like to, to do some gigs with Gary Larson sometime. That should be fun.

ctx.x: In fact, what I, what I did… I tuned… a lot of that… I used to do that with Gary Larson, the Far Side guy, who was… He would come… I told you, with, with his imagination and everything, his guitar-playing was very middle-of-the-road. So I’d take his guitar and tune it randomly, and I’d say, “Okay, Gary, make something outta this.” Didn’t I tell you that?
Yeah, but I didn’t know you did it with Gary. I saw you do it in a class one day at the New School.
